prose: EE Times reports, relayed by Techmeme, that DeepX taped out its DX-M2 edge accelerator and is targeting mass production in fall 2027. Claims about running very large language models on robots and drones are product targets, not verified field performance. Tape-out is a development milestone, not shipping availability.
highlights: Mass production is a future target
Edge robotics is the intended market
basis: Techmeme headline and excerpt; original source fetch failed.
